text:
Ava: Heads-up — found a sticky sugar canister caked into the sink and a mug ring of jam in the microwave. My sleeve is now an abstract art piece :sob: Who used the sugar last? Also the kettle has been low for the last 2 mornings, can we do a quick rota?
Sam: Not me, was on a call earlier. I can drop by with a spare box of granulated sugar at ~4pm. Is regular white ok? :coffee:
Priya: white is fine. Re: microwave, could we put a simple label? people keep nuking mugs with lids and it gets gross. small sign > big lecture. :shrug:
Luca: that was me, sorry — jam mug was mine, spilled while reheating. I wiped what I could, missed the ring. I'll clean fully now and grab oat milk + sugar tomorrow AM. Sorry team.
Jamie: rota sounds good. We can do weekly turns: one person checks kettle + restocks basics on Mon mornings. I can make a tiny sign-up sheet in the kitchen or a google sheet if folks prefer. :hand:
Maya: I can coordinate the rota. Proposed: Week 1 - Jamie, Week 2 - Sam, Week 3 - Priya, Week 4 - Luca (then repeat). Reply here if you want added.
Ava: thanks Maya — and Jamie, sheet would be great. For the sign, something short like: "KITCHEN QUICK RULES: 1) Label your food, 2) Remove your mug from microwave when done, 3) If you empty the kettle/sugar/coffee please replace or note in the sheet"
Priya: here's a tiny printable label I mocked up — feel free to copy:```KITCHEN ETIQUETTE
• Remove your mug after heating
• No uncovered saucers
• Replace sugar/oatmilk/filters you finish
• If you spill, wipe it now```
Sam: :thumbsup: will print 10 and stick them by the kettle + microwave. Also pinging facilities about the microwave hinge — it's sticking when it closes.
kitchen-bot: Inventory check complete. Items low: sugar (1 box), oat milk (1 carton), coffee (2 bags). Threshold reached: sugar. Please reorder.
Luca: re: facilities — thanks. I put a short note on MAINT-4523 for the hinge squeak.
Jamie: OK everyone — if you want on the rota, just reply here with "me" and I'll add you to the sheet. I'll paste the link once it's up.
Priya: me
Sam: me (but I'll swap weeks if someone needs)
Maya: added Priya + Sam + Jamie + Luca. Ava you said you might prefer no rota? (just volunteer)
Ava: I'm happy to be a backup, not weekly. Thanks all for picking this up! :relieved:
Sam: I brought sugar — left a new box by the kettle. Also put a sticky note on the microwave: "If it's yours, wipe it."
